records.chunk: Fixed Deposit (FD) types: Standard FD (fixed tenure and rate), Tax-Saver FD (5-year lock-in, Section 80C benefit), Senior Citizen FD (additional 0.5% rate for customers aged 60+), Flexi FD (linked to savings account with sweep facility), and NRE/NRO FD for NRIs.

Interest rates are tiered by tenure: 7-44 days: 5.0%, 6 months to <1 year: 6.0%, 1-3 years: 6.5%, 3-5 years: 6.75%. Rates are effective from 2026-03-01 and are subject to periodic revision by the bank.

FD tenures range from 7 days to 10 years. Cumulative FDs pay interest at maturity; non-cumulative (monthly/quarterly payout) FDs pay interest periodically during the tenure. Interest is compounded quarterly for cumulative FDs.

Premature closure penalty: 1% of principal if closed within 1 year, 0.5% between 1-3 years. No penalty after 3 years or within 15 days of booking. For senior citizens, penalty is reduced by 0.25%. Post-maturity closure: no penalty.

TDS at 10% is deducted on FD interest exceeding Rs 40,000 per financial year (Rs 50,000 for senior citizens). Form 15G/15H can be submitted to avoid TDS if total income is below the taxable threshold. Interest income is taxable under income from other sources.
